question: How long did it take to move to the new apartment?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] I'm looking for some recommendations on good coffee shops near my new apartment. I just moved in a few weeks ago and still exploring the area.

[turn 2] It's in the city, near my new apartment which is about 20 minutes away from my old place. I'm open to trying unique or independent coffee shops, and would prefer ones with free Wi-Fi and outdoor seating.

[turn 4] I actually drove to my parents' house last weekend and it took around 2 hours. The drive back was quite tiring, especially since I had a long day at work on Monday.

[turn 6] I'm actually in the city, and my new apartment is about 20 minutes away from my old place. I've been trying to explore the area, and I found a few decent restaurants and coffee shops nearby when I went to finalize the paperwork and pick up the keys a week before the move.

[turn 8] I didn't think about asking the baristas for recommendations. That's a great idea! By the way, it took me and my friends around 5 hours to move everything into the new apartment, but it was worth it to be closer to work and save on commute time.

[turn 10] I've been trying to incorporate more walking into my daily routine, and I've started taking the stairs instead of the elevator at work.
